questions.q: A new project lands on your desk. First, you want to know…
When someone hands you finished work, you notice first…
A good result reached a different way than yours…
questions.b: I'd rather it was done my way

questions.q: How much do you want to approve before it goes out?
The best way to get an update from your team is…
questions.a: A written note I read when I'm ready

questions.q: When something is unclear, you'd rather…

questions.b: A draft that's 100% right on Friday

questions.q: Before something goes to a client, you want…
questions.a: It out fast; fix it later if needed

visionary.name: The Visionary
visionary.line: You set the direction and want it handled. You think in outcomes and lose energy in the details.
rh: Owns outcomes end to end, not task lists
Brings you decisions, never problems without options
Decides alone on anything inside your limits and tells you after
visionary.sop: Short SOPs: the outcome, the rules and when to escalate. Skip step-by-step detail the Right Hand can work out.
visionary.decide: The Right Hand decides alone on everything inside the dollar limit and the rules, and lists those decisions in the update.

captain.name: The Captain
captain.line: You lead from the front and like to steer. You want the big calls to stay yours, without doing the legwork.
rh: Prepares 2–3 options for every decision, with a recommendation
Runs the follow-through the moment you decide
Keeps a decisions log so nothing waits on your memory
captain.sop: SOPs centred on decision points: what the Right Hand prepares, what you choose, and what happens after.
captain.decide: The Right Hand prepares and recommends; you make the final call on anything client-facing or new. Routine items follow the rules.

craftsman.name: The Craftsman
craftsman.line: You care how things are done, not just that they're done. Quality is your signature, and it's why letting go is hard.
rh: Works from detailed SOPs with examples of your standard
Shows you work at agreed checkpoints in the first 30 days
Earns autonomy task by task as the checkpoints pass
craftsman.sop: Detailed SOPs: numbered steps, an example of a good result, and a quality checklist for every task.
craftsman.decide: For the first 30 days you review at checkpoints; each task moves to 'decides alone' once it passes two reviews in a row.

systems.name: The Architect
systems.line: You like things to run on rules, not on you. You'd rather design the system once than touch it every day.
rh: Documents every process and keeps the SOPs current
Runs the systems and reports by exception
Suggests a rule or automation whenever something repeats
systems.sop: Rule-based SOPs: triggers, if/then rules, and what gets automated vs done by hand.
systems.decide: The Right Hand follows the rules without asking and only escalates exceptions the rules don't cover.

async.label: Async
async.update: A written update at the end of each day (done / in progress / blocked / needs your decision). Urgent items only by direct message.

live.label: Live
live.update: A 10-minute check-in call each day, followed by a short written recap of what was agreed.

fast.label: Fast
fast.drafts: Send 80% drafts early and improve them in the open. Speed beats polish on internal work.

deliberate.label: Deliberate
deliberate.drafts: Double-check before anything goes out, and flag risks before they become problems. Polish beats speed on client-facing work.

fast.name: The Trailblazer
fast.tag: Sees it first. Gets there first.
fast.line: You see where things are going and want to be there yesterday. You'd rather launch and adjust than wait for perfect.
fast.pain: New ideas outrun the follow-through, so half-launched projects wait on you.
fast.gain: Your ideas get shipped while you're already on the next one.

deliberate.name: The Visionary
deliberate.tag: Sets the direction. Hates the details.
deliberate.line: You set the direction and want it handled well. You think in outcomes, lose energy in the details, and like big moves thought through.
deliberate.pain: You set the direction, then get pulled into details that drain you.
deliberate.gain: The direction stays yours; the details get owned end to end.

fast.name: The Commander
fast.tag: Decides fast. Keeps the big calls.
fast.line: You lead from the front and decide fast. You want the big calls to stay yours and everything else moving now.
fast.pain: Every decision waits on your yes, so the team stalls when you're busy.
fast.gain: Options arrive ready to decide, and follow-through starts the moment you do.

deliberate.name: The Captain
deliberate.tag: Steers carefully. Keeps the big calls.
deliberate.line: You like to steer, and you weigh the big calls before you make them. You want them to stay yours, without doing the legwork.
deliberate.pain: You weigh the big calls, but the prep and legwork land on you too.
deliberate.gain: Every big call arrives prepared with options, and you keep the final say.

fast.name: The Maker
fast.tag: Builds it fast. Then makes it great.
fast.line: You care how things are made, and you like making them quickly. You'd rather improve a real draft than plan the perfect one.
fast.pain: You build fast, so you end up building everything yourself.
fast.gain: Your drafts get finished, polished and shipped by someone who follows your lead.

deliberate.name: The Craftsman
deliberate.tag: Quality is the signature. Letting go is hard.
deliberate.line: You care how things are done, not just that they're done. Quality is your signature, and it's why letting go is hard.
deliberate.pain: Your standard is high, so nothing leaves your desk without you.
deliberate.gain: Your standard gets written down and met, so you can let go task by task.

fast.name: The Optimizer
fast.tag: Fixes the process the moment it slows.
fast.line: You hate doing anything twice. You fix the process the moment it slows you down, and you'd rather automate today than plan for next month.
fast.pain: You fix the process yourself every time it slows, on top of your real work.
fast.gain: Someone runs and improves your systems, and only flags you on exceptions.

deliberate.name: The Architect
deliberate.tag: Designs it once. Never touches it again.
deliberate.line: You like things to run on rules, not on you. You design the system carefully once so you never have to touch it again.
deliberate.pain: You designed the system, but you're still the one keeping it running.
deliberate.gain: The rules run without you; you only see the exceptions they don't cover.
